jobs.title: 🇩🇪 Fullstack-Developer (100% Remote / German-Speaking)
jobs.facts: Fluent German is required for this role. | Our customers are property management companies in Germany. | We're looking for Junior and Senior Developers for our fully remote team who want to be responsible for a part of the product: talking to the property managers who use it, deciding what to build next and making sure it works for them. | You work on this directly with the customer: importing years of email, hundreds of thousands of documents, and every record on their buildings, apartments, contracts and contacts, plus syncing with systems a customer still runs alongside us. | Our minimalistic tech stack Everything is TypeScript. | Requirements You are: fluent in German and English.
